name: Licorice absolute
description: Licorice absolute (CAS 84775-66-6 ), also known as liquorice absolute and referenced under FEMA 2628 , is a concentrated botanical extract derived from Glycyrrhiza glabra root. It delivers the characteristic deep, sweet, anise-like flavor profile that defines licorice as a recognizable taste category in commercial formulation. In food and confectionery manufacturing, it functions as a natural flavoring agent in candies, chewing gums, and liqueurs where authentic licorice character is required. Beverage formulators use it to build complexity in herbal teas, soft drinks, and functional beverages targeting botanical or wellness positioning. Fragrance houses incorporate it into perfume compositions and personal care products, particularly in masculine and oriental fragrance families, where its earthy-sweet depth adds base note character. Pharmaceutical manufacturers apply it as a flavor masking and palatability agent in oral dosage forms. This extract is commonly utilized in the production of syrups, lozenges, and chewable tablets to improve the patient experience. Licorice absolute is supplied as a viscous, dark-colored liquid or semi-solid extract, depending on the specific processing method and solvent system used during extraction. It is available in food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications to meet the compliance requirements of different end markets. Buyers should confirm FEMA 2628 recognition and regional flavor regulation compliance when sourcing for food applications to ensure safety and quality. The material is handled according to strict industry protocols to maintain its chemical integrity and aromatic potency. As a versatile ingredient, it bridges the gap between traditional herbal medicine and modern industrial applications in the global chemical and flavor marketplace.
